dispositions.finding: Codex H1 / Claude M5: fresh or stale same-attempt request bypasses the static generation fence
dispositions.resolution: The exact-current path now requires a token-validated, typed command record for the exact content-addressed command ID and an exact result/current-binding match. Otherwise the normal fenced command rejects the request. RED tests cover both fresh same-attempt reuse and a stale leader.

dispositions.finding: Codex M1: identical malformed bytes collide when replayed under a later epoch
dispositions.resolution: The first-observer invalid disposition remains immutable. Replay validates the retained raw-byte history, digest, rejection and classification, then removes only the identical hot entry. A cross-epoch RED test verifies byte-for-byte stability and neighboring request progress.

dispositions.finding: Claude H1: same-logical static rerun behavior was ambiguous and no production terminal-evidence producer exists
dispositions.resolution: The safe supported contract is now explicit in plan section 9.2/9.4 and MODE-02: deterministic authority-terminal evidence permits expected-generation rebinding; an active, paused, heartbeat-expired or scheduler-uncertain attempt never self-authorizes and requires an exact operator old/new-fence authorization. P4 does not add an unsafe timeout-based terminal inference.

dispositions.finding: Claude M1: learner rereads a removable hot request to derive its digest
dispositions.resolution: Static and dynamic publication APIs return the digest derived from the exact in-memory canonical payload. The learner no longer rereads the hot path; a RED test removes the published file before digest consumption.

dispositions.finding: Claude M2: broad deferral swallows stale-token, schema and internal admission invariant errors
dispositions.resolution: StaleLeaderTokenError, AuthoritySchemaError and AdmissionInvariantError now propagate ahead of the retryable OSError/RuntimeError boundary; the exact-current replay also verifies the token before and after its read.

dispositions.finding: Claude M4: a rejected disposition from an old epoch is invisible to a waiting learner
dispositions.resolution: A successor validates the retained disposition and old rejection, republishes an equivalent request-specific rejection in its current epoch, then archives the hot request. The public learner reader test observes the rejection after takeover.

dispositions.finding: Claude L3: Checker source fallback, dirty evidence acceptance and omitted root main.py
dispositions.resolution: Runtime evidence source fallback uses only checks.requirements_source_commit, explicit dirty or malformed cleanliness markers fail, and source-equivalence includes main.py. Three Checker regressions cover all cases.

dispositions.finding: Claude L2: MODE-02 named a CUDA allocation counter without direct counter evidence
dispositions.resolution: The matrix and plan now name the actual proof: the production pre-torch import sentinel fires before torch import, model load or device allocation, so a rejected/waiting process cannot reach any production torch/CUDA allocation path.

dispositions.finding: Claude L5: ContributorResumeState does not type-validate decoded fields
dispositions.resolution: ContributorResumeState.__post_init__ already applies strict_int to cursor, next_cycle_seq and optional stream_epoch, and validates receipt identity/digest coupling. Decoders instantiate this type and translate its ValueError into protocol failure.

dispositions.finding: Codex L1 / Claude M3: persistent unreadable hot-entry telemetry is unbounded
dispositions.resolution: P6 must add per-path observation fingerprints, bounded repeat diagnostics/backoff and changed/recovered events, then verify bounded event/fsync behavior across repeated scans.

dispositions.finding: Claude L1: admission request reads have no byte-size limit
dispositions.resolution: P6 must apply a pre-read regular-file size bound plus bounded read enforcement and exact boundary/oversize tests before the 10,000-cycle gate.

dispositions.finding: Claude L4: current admission repair performs O(N) immutable publication work every poll
dispositions.resolution: P6 must make repair event-driven or cache the current-epoch fence set, and measure that steady-state metadata work does not grow with contributor history or poll count.

dispositions.finding: Claude L6: admission request SHA/command identity is incompatible with an in-progress old run root
dispositions.resolution: P5 must document that the v4 cutover is fresh-run-only and that in-flight roots produced before newline canonicalization/stable command identity are query-only, not resumable.
